follower_rules.ranked_on: a 90% lower bound on the net SOL over closed copies (net - 1.645 x sd x sqrt(closed)), 1 slot behind, 20+ closed
follower_rules.forward_test: each wallet scored on the 14-28 days before a week and read on that week (six folds, Oct 2026): the top 25 of the whole list lost a follower money in every fold; the followable top 25 was about as often up as down. A past follower record is a weak signal, not a list that pays
follower_rules.how: each buy the wallet made, entered by a follower N slots later with the size in SOL at that trade's reserves, exited N slots after the wallet's next sell of the coin; pump.fun's curve fee and PumpSwap's fee at the coin's market-cap tier each way; open copies (no sell yet) are counted apart

stream.what: Every pump.fun create, trade, graduation and migration, pushed over a WebSocket about 1.5 s after its block
stream.trial: 7 days free on a free key: POST https://pumpdata.fun/stream/trial with x-api-key (a key: https://pumpdata.fun/keys)

forward_test: Measured Oct 29: the Oct 24 list's wallets three days later (realized SOL). Followable: 91 made money, 93 lost; the top 25 followable, median -0.69 SOL among those that traded. The whole leaderboard: 938 up, 599 down. A past record says who won; for followable wallets it did not say who wins next. Short window; re-read with each build.
